name: doc-user-stories
description: Writes a Story Set from a PRD section, with stories in "As a, I want, so that" form, Given / When / Then acceptance criteria, an INVEST check per story and questions for refinement. Use for "run doc-user-stories", "write user stories", "acceptance criteria", "Given When Then", "INVEST check", "break the PRD into stories", "engineers say the requirements are not detailed enough", "prepare for backlog refinement", part of the Claude Docs for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
